description:
Advances: specled.package, specled.branch_guard

Scope expansion carved from specled_-q0q.2 grader findings: the S2 merge added an eleventh append_only finding code and superseded the v1 budget ADR, leaving three stale statements S3 cannot fix (lib is out of scope there). Full contract in the first comment on this ticket.

comments.text:
CONTRACT (orchestrator-authored; treat as the ticket body)

Deliverable:
1. docs/concepts.md:491 — the sentence stating the append-only finding set "is budgeted (ten codes — see specled.decision.append_only_finding_budget)" is now false. Update to eleven codes and reference specled.decision.append_only_finding_budget_v2 (the v1 ADR is superseded).
2. lib/specled_ex/branch_check.ex:25 — comment still says "append_only/* (10 ratified codes)"; update the count.
3. lib/specled_ex/branch_check.ex @per_code_defaults — add the "append_only/self_authorized_weakening" => :info entry so the map matches the mirror role the docs lint comment (test/docs_identifier_lint_test.exs:79) ascribes to it. Behavior-identical: render_findings/2 already falls back to the builder severity.

Spec co-change is AUTHORIZED where the gate forces it: the smallest edits to .spec/specs/package.spec.md / branch_guard.spec.md / implementation_tier.spec.md that keep branch_guard_missing_subject_update green, and .spec/realization_hashes.json refresh if the branch_check.ex touch drifts a named binding.

Verification:
- Tests to pass: mix test test/docs_identifier_lint_test.exs; any package.spec doc verification commands touching docs/concepts.md
- Iteration tier: targeted files + mix spec.check --no-run-commands
- Final tier: bash ./scripts/check_specs.sh run-until-green, plus mix compile --warnings-as-errors, mix test, mix format --check-formatted, mix deps.unlock --check-unused, make xref

Allowed touches:
- docs/concepts.md
- lib/specled_ex/branch_check.ex (the line-25 comment and the @per_code_defaults map entry ONLY)
- .spec/specs/package.spec.md, .spec/specs/branch_guard.spec.md, .spec/specs/implementation_tier.spec.md (gate-forced minimal co-change only)
- .spec/realization_hashes.json (binding refresh only if forced)
- test/docs_identifier_lint_test.exs (only if a gate mechanically forces it; none expected)

Out of Scope (files): VERSION, CHANGELOG.md, lib/specled_ex/append_only.ex, lib/specled_ex/overlap.ex, .spec/decisions/**
Out of Scope (intent): no behavior change anywhere — the @per_code_defaults entry must be behavior-identical (:info matches the builder); no rewrites of existing spec statements; no other doc edits.

Merge gate:
- [ ] mix compile --warnings-as-errors; targeted tests; bash ./scripts/check_specs.sh
- [ ] mix format --check-formatted, mix deps.unlock --check-unused, make xref
- [ ] Scope check: diff touches only Allowed globs
- [ ] Auditor APPROVE comment on the ticket

IMPLEMENTED
Session: grok-q0q4-i1
Log: /Users/mz/.local/state/agentic-runs/specled_ex/specled_-q0q.4/grok-q0q4-i1/log

Commit: b76b48a4438523a6f1022fbf5eb6544107bcc0fd
Files touched: docs/concepts.md, lib/specled_ex/branch_check.ex, .spec/specs/package.spec.md, .spec/specs/implementation_tier.spec.md
Tests added: none — doc/comment sweep
Verification stubs flipped: none
Verification tier: final — bash ./scripts/check_specs.sh; mix compile --warnings-as-errors; mix test; mix format --check-formatted; mix deps.unlock --check-unused; make xref
Final-tier runs: 1

Summary: Corrected docs/concepts.md from ten→eleven append_only codes and pointed at append_only_finding_budget_v2. Mirrored append_only/self_authorized_weakening => :info in BranchCheck @per_code_defaults (behavior-identical to builder severity) and updated the ratified-count comment to 11. Gate-forced reconciliation notes on package + implementation_tier; Spec-Drift trailer for non-policy cross-cutting; realization_hashes untouched (BranchCheck.run/3 attested clean).

VERIFY: PASS
Session: 63655cb6-965a-48c3-bb59-64da6ce31142
Log: /Users/mz/.claude-personal/projects/-Users-mz-src-specled-ex/63655cb6-965a-48c3-bb59-64da6ce31142.jsonl

Base confirmed: git merge-base HEAD specled_-q0q/s0n-selfauth-debug-fixes = 871ac2a5. Commit under review: b76b48a4.

Mechanical checks:
- Files touched: 4 — docs/concepts.md, lib/specled_ex/branch_check.ex, .spec/specs/package.spec.md, .spec/specs/implementation_tier.spec.md
- Files outside Allowed globs: 0
- Files matching Out-of-Scope globs: 0 (VERSION, CHANGELOG.md, append_only.ex, overlap.ex, .spec/decisions/** all untouched)
- Gate-forced spec touches: BOTH forced, proven at commit level. The working-tree revert test the contract suggests is INVALID here: ChangeAnalysis.changed_files/3 unions scope_diff (`git diff --name-only base...HEAD`, three-dot) with working-tree/staged/untracked, so reverting a file in the tree leaves it in the changed set via the committed diff (changed_files stayed 5, no new finding). I rebuilt each counterfactual as a real commit on a detached HEAD off 871ac2a5 (branch ref never moved; tree restored and re-verified clean afterward):
  * package.spec.md omitted -> [ERROR] branch_guard_missing_subject_update docs/concepts.md :: impacts subject specs that were not updated: specled.package; spec.check result=fail tier=branch error_findings=1. FORCED.
  * implementation_tier.spec.md omitted -> [ERROR] branch_guard_missing_subject_update lib/specled_ex/branch_check.ex :: impacts subject specs that were not updated: specled.implementation_tier; result=fail. FORCED.
  * branch_guard.spec.md correctly NOT touched — the realization attestation on SpecLedEx.BranchCheck.run/3 downgrades its finding to info on its own.
  Minimality: package.spec.md is purely additive (5 lines, 0 removed). implementation_tier.spec.md replaces 3 prose lines — see Notes; ruled acceptable. Neither touches a requirement block; no must weakened; no statement rewritten in the requirements YAML.
- Spec-Drift trailer: `Spec-Drift: branch_guard_missing_decision_update=info`. Trailer.read/2 scans `git log base..HEAD --format=%B` and projects `<code>=<severity>` into a per-code override at trailer precedence. Counterfactual C (identical tree, trailer removed from the commit message) yields [ERROR] branch_guard_missing_decision_update, result=fail error_findings=1. So it suppressed exactly one finding, error->info, and nothing else (the second info finding, the attested missing_subject_update, is present with or without it). LEGITIMATE: the finding's own fix: block offers exactly two remedies — author/revise an ADR, or record this trailer with a one-line reason — and .spec/decisions/** is explicit Out of Scope on this ticket. The change is doc/comment/map-mirror staleness, not durable cross-cutting policy, and the eleventh code is already recorded in the accepted v2 ADR. The commit body carries the required one-line reason. Not a case of a trailer silencing something an in-scope edit should have fixed.

Semantic checks:
- Code-count claims: actual count derived independently = 11 distinct append_only/* codes, all emitted by builders in lib/specled_ex/append_only.ex at lines 377, 393, 409, 425, 441, 458, 484, 511, 528, 544, 558 (grep -oE '"append_only/[a-z_]+"' | sort -u). branch_check.ex @per_code_defaults now carries exactly those 11 (lines 26-36). Both amended claims — docs/concepts.md:491 "eleven codes" and branch_check.ex:25 "(11 ratified codes)" — match reality.
- ADR reference: specled.decision.append_only_finding_budget_v2.md exists; frontmatter status: accepted, change_type: supersedes, replaces: [specled.decision.append_only_finding_budget]; its Decision section reads "Ratified codes (11 append_only + 2 overlap)", so "eleven" is the correct append_only-only figure for this sentence. The v1 ADR carries status: superseded and superseded_by: ..._v2. No stale current-tense citation of v1 remains in docs/, lib/, or .spec/specs/ — the only surviving v1 mentions are CHANGELOG.md:1034 (historical release entry, out of scope and correct as history) and two cross-references inside .spec/decisions/ (append-only records, out of scope).
- Behavior-identity of @per_code_defaults entry: CONFIRMED, including the non-obvious paths. The sole emitter of append_only/self_authorized_weakening is append_only.ex:523-529, which hardcodes severity: :info — same value as the new map entry. There are three readers of @per_code_defaults: render_findings/2 (branch_check.ex:439) uses `Map.get(@per_code_defaults, finding.code, finding.severity)`, i.e. builder fallback, so :info -> :info is a no-op; emit/6 (:190) and realization_findings/3 (:272) both fall back to :warning and WOULD have changed behavior — but I checked every call site (emit/6 at lines 75, 103, 240, 354, 368, 511; realization_findings over realization output) and all of them pass branch_guard_* codes only. No append_only/* code can reach either. Diff on lib/ is exactly one comment line changed plus one map entry added; nothing else.
- Intent-level scope concerns: none rising to a Gap. See Notes for two stale sibling lists the contract put out of reach.
- Targeted verification (all in the stage worktree at b76b48a4): mix compile --warnings-as-errors PASS; mix format --check-formatted PASS; mix test test/docs_identifier_lint_test.exs 19 tests 0 failures; mix test test/specled_ex/branch_check/severity_integration_test.exs 23 tests 0 failures; mix spec.check --no-run-commands --base 871ac2a5 -> spec.check result=pass, findings=2 (error=0 warning=0 info=2); package.spec.md verification block at lines 158-166 (kind: command, execute: true, greps the verdict-read protocol in docs/concepts.md) run by hand, RC=0.
- Corpus-scoped claims: 6 validated, 5 by execution (11-code count by grep over emitters; branch_check map count by grep; v2 ADR existence/status by file read; v1 superseded by file read; v1-citation sweep by repo-wide grep; concepts.md verdict-protocol grep by running the spec-verification command). Falsehoods introduced or left standing in the touched region: none.
- Realization drift: zero. spec.check --no-run-commands --base 871ac2a5 reports no branch_guard_realization_* finding of any kind; the only branch_check.ex finding is an attested missing_subject_update naming SpecLedEx.BranchCheck.run/3 as clean. .spec/realization_hashes.json correctly untouched — the implementer's claim holds.
- Requirements coverage: this ticket changes no behavior, so no new tests are expected and none were added — stating that explicitly rather than inventing coverage. The must statements whose surfaces the diff touches both still hold and both still verify: specled.package.concepts_guide (docs/concepts.md still carries every element the statement enumerates, incl. the verdict-read protocol the execute: true command greps) and specled.package.doc_identifier_integrity (the hand-maintained mirror requirement — "shall add every new code in those guarded families in the same change that introduces its emitter" — is what this ticket is finishing; docs_identifier_lint_test.exs green). specled.branch_guard and specled.implementation_tier requirement text is untouched; only Verification-section prose moved.
- Full-suite verification: not run by verifier (by design)

Verdict: PASS

Notes (advisory only, none blocking):
1. lib/specled_ex/review/html.ex:1121-1130 — the "Decisions / governance" leg's `codes:` list still enumerates only 10 append_only codes; self_authorized_weakening is missing. This is not cosmetic: line 1146 computes `count = Enum.sum(Enum.map(c.codes, &Map.get(fbc, &1, 0)))`, so a self_authorized_weakening finding never counts toward that leg and the review HTML renders it as passed. Staleness introduced by specled_-q0q.2, and html.ex is not in this ticket's Allowed touches, so the implementer could not have fixed it here. Recommend a follow-up ticket before 0.13.0 ships.
2. test/specled_ex/branch_check/severity_integration_test.exs:352-363 — the `append_only_codes` table under the describe block titled "@per_code_defaults covers every finding code emitted by this project" still lists 10 rows. The block's title is now an overclaim: it asserts presence, not exhaustiveness, so it passes while under-covering the eleventh code. Also out of Allowed touches; same follow-up.
3. implementation_tier.spec.md is the one non-additive edit: it overwrites a branch reconciliation note first committed in 402f4a27 (release 0.9.5, long merged) that read "This branch changes only its --base pre-flight validation seam". I ruled this minimal rather than a rewrite-of-an-existing-statement violation because the gate required the file to change, the overwritten sentence was already false on main, and appending beside it would have left a false statement in the file during a ticket whose entire purpose is deleting false statements. Flagging so the auditor rules on it rather than inheriting my call.
4. package.spec.md now carries a branch-scoped note ("This branch only corrects...") while specled.package.declarative_governance (a stable must in that same file) requires `.spec` be "declarative and current-state only, using ADRs for durable cross-cutting policy and Git history for change over time". The tension is pre-existing and idiomatic here — 6 spec files carry a "Branch reconciliation note", 5 of them from before this branch — but the epic is accreting prose that goes stale the moment it merges. Worth a design decision at some point, not this ticket.
5. docs/concepts.md:483-487, inside the touched paragraph: the detector prose enumerates 8 of the 11 codes (no_baseline, adr_affects_widened and self_authorized_weakening are absent). The phrasing is "emits findings for X, Y, Z" with no totality marker, so it is incomplete rather than false — but it sits two sentences above "the finding set is budgeted (eleven codes)", which invites a reader to count the list and come up three short. Cheap to tighten in a future doc pass.

AUDIT: APPROVE
Session: 63655cb6-965a-48c3-bb59-64da6ce31142
Log: /Users/mz/.claude-personal/projects/-Users-mz-src-specled-ex/63655cb6-965a-48c3-bb59-64da6ce31142.jsonl

Reasoning: Re-counted the diff independently — 4 files, all inside Allowed globs, and every Out-of-Scope file (VERSION, CHANGELOG.md, append_only.ex, overlap.ex, .spec/decisions/**) untouched. The 11-code claim holds from both directions: 11 distinct append_only/* literals in append_only.ex emitters, 11 entries in @per_code_defaults, and the v2 ADR's Decision heading reads "Ratified codes (11 append_only + 2 overlap)" (the ADR title's "Thirteen" is the combined figure, so the docs sentence — which sits inside the "Append-only ADR governance" section of concepts.md — is correctly scoped, not contradictory). v1 carries status: superseded with superseded_by pointing at v2. No claim in the VERIFY comment was accepted on assertion; each load-bearing one is re-derived below.

Note 3 ruling — CONFIRM the verifier. The hunk lands at implementation_tier.spec.md:240-243, in the "## Verification" prose region after the spec-scenarios fence closes at :235 and before the spec-verification YAML at :245. It carries no `statement:` key, so it is not a spec statement in specled's vocabulary and the "no rewrites of existing spec statements" constraint is not breached. `git blame -L 238,244 871ac2a5` attributes the overwritten text to 402f4a27 (release 0.9.5, PR #28, 2026-07-26), and `git log main..871ac2a5 -- lib/specled_ex/branch_check.ex` is empty — branch_check.ex at the base was identical to main, so "This branch changes only its `--base` pre-flight validation seam" described a branch merged nine days earlier and was already false. The replacement kept both the framing clause and the invariant clause ("dispatch and hashing semantics remain unchanged"); only the middle claim moved. Appending would have left a false sentence standing in a file whose ticket exists to delete false sentences. Minimal, not a rewrite.

Spec-Drift trailer — CONFIRMED, exactly one finding suppressed. The trailer is a single explicit `<code>=<severity>` token (`branch_guard_missing_decision_update=info`), not a preset; Trailer projects tokens into a string-keyed per-code override map, so by construction it cannot reach any other code. That finding's own fix: block at branch_check.ex:107-110 offers exactly two remedies — author/revise an ADR, or "record `Spec-Drift: branch_guard_missing_decision_update=info` as a git trailer on a commit in this range, with a one-line reason in the commit body". `.spec/decisions/**` is explicit Out of Scope here, so the trailer was the only reachable remedy, and the commit body carries the reason line ("Doc/comment/map-mirror staleness only — not durable cross-cutting policy; the v2 budget ADR already records the eleventh code").

@per_code_defaults call-site spot-check — CONFIRMED independently, no behavior change hides there. Three readers: :190 (emit/6, :warning fallback), :272 (realization_findings/3, :warning fallback), :439 (render_findings/2, builder fallback). All six emit/6 call sites — 75, 103, 240, 354, 368, 511 — pass branch_guard_* string literals only (unmapped_change, missing_decision_update, realization_unknown_tier, missing_subject_update x2, requirement_without_test_tag); none is dynamic. realization_findings/3 is fed only realization_raw from run_realization at :63. append_only/* therefore reaches only render_findings/2 (called at :418 with append_only_raw/overlap_raw), which falls back to finding.severity. The sole emitter, append_only.ex:524-531, hardcodes severity: :info, and the v2 ADR table row at :51 independently says :info — so :info -> :info is a genuine no-op on all three paths.

SECOND-GRADER STATEMENT on Notes 1-2: YES. I name these as out-of-scope work that MUST land before 0.13.0 ships, and the carve is LARGER than the verifier sized it.

Note 1 is a live violation of specled.spec_review.triangle_code_classification (spec_review.spec.md:234, priority: must), which requires that `append_only/*` findings shall flip a dedicated "Decisions / governance" checklist row. html.ex:1121-1130 lists 10 of 11; :1146 sums the count over that list and :1151 sets `passed?: count == 0`, so a live self_authorized_weakening finding renders the governance row green. The list is not severity-filtered — append_only/no_baseline (:info) is already in it — so this is oversight, not a deliberate exclusion of :info codes.

NEW, beyond the verifier's notes: the guard for that very must is stale in the same way, so the false-green is double-locked. test/specled_ex/review/html_test.exs:147 is a test titled "the row covers every append_only/* code in the catalog" — but it iterates @append_only_codes at :127-138, a hand-maintained 10-code list in the test file, and the per-code flip table at :157-168 repeats the same 10. The exhaustiveness assertion is made against a stale catalog and passes green. Full carve for the scope-expansion child: lib/specled_ex/review/html.ex:1121-1130; test/specled_ex/review/html_test.exs:127-138 and :157-168; test/specled_ex/branch_check/severity_integration_test.exs:353-364 (Note 2, whose describe title at :339 claims exhaustiveness while the assertion only runs table->map presence). Four hand-maintained mirrors are stale; test/docs_identifier_lint_test.exs:74-88 is the only one of the five already correct.

Recommendation for that child: derive these lists from the emitters rather than adding an eleventh row to four parallel copies. docs_identifier_lint_test.exs:55-62 explicitly defends hand-maintenance as "fail loudly" design, and this incident is that idiom failing at four of five sites simultaneously — which is also why the 0.13.0 review artifact would ship rendering "Every spec edit honors append-only governance" as passed while a governance finding is live.

Not a bounce: all four files sit outside this ticket's Allowed touches and the staleness was introduced by specled_-q0q.2, exactly as the verifier stated. Verifier output was correct on every point I retraced; my only delta is enlarging the Note-1 carve. Verifier Notes 4 and 5 I concur with as non-blocking, and Note 4 is sharpened by this ticket adding two more branch-reconciliation notes that go stale the moment 0.13.0 merges.
APPROVED. Merged into specled_-q0q/s0n-selfauth-debug-fixes. Closing per orchestrator sign-off.
